summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper, standard library only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing committed. Tests, black, and flake8 were not run; line lengths were checked by measurement only and are under 120. Choices: items lacking image or label pass through without error; a non-list value under the key raises ValueError; loader returns shallow copies of items.
